title: Tortoise and the Ducks | Bedtime Story | باخه و دو مرغابی
description:
The Tortoise and the Two Ducks: an animated bedtime story for kids from Kalila & Dimna, the ancient book of Persian fables. A tortoise flies high in the sky, holding a stick in his mouth... could YOU stay quiet up there?

قصه‌ی «باخه و دو مرغابی» از کلیله و دمنه، به زبان انگلیسی با انیمیشن و موسیقی سنتور؛ برای بچه‌های ایرانی در سراسر دنیا و همه‌ی بچه‌هایی که قصه دوست دارند.

A kind but very chatty tortoise lives by a little pond with his two best friends, two ducks. One hot summer the pond dries up, and the ducks must fly to the big blue lake over the hills. But a tortoise cannot fly! So the ducks have a clever idea: they hold a stick, and the tortoise bites its middle. Just one rule: don't open your mouth, not one word! High over a village, the children laugh: "What a silly tortoise!" And the tortoise wants to answer so much... Kalila and Dimna, our two jackal storytellers, tell you what happens next. (Nobody gets hurt: he lands in a big, soft haystack!)

Moral of the story: Think before you speak. Your words can wait a little!
Persian word of the day: لاک‌پشت (laak-posht) = tortoise (a shell on the back!).

ABOUT KALILA & DIMNA
Kalila & Dimna is a book of animal fables that began as the ancient Indian Panchatantra. It was translated into Middle Persian, then into Arabic by Ibn al-Muqaffa, and later into Persian, becoming one of the most widely translated story collections in the world.

This is an original animated adaptation of a public-domain classic. The script, animation, character voices and santur music were all made for this channel, to share the wisdom of Persian storytelling with children everywhere.
